axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Axiom, the leading provider of on-demand legal talent globally, is seeking a senior corporate lawyer at Special Counsel level to provide proactive, practical and pragmatic legal and governance support across a global business. The successful candidate will have a broad corporate background with experience across APAC/ANZ financing, corporate paperwork and intercompany arrangements, ideally with exposure to ASX- and NASDAQ-listed environments. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract opportunity commencing in October/November, with a hybrid working arrangement of 3 days in the office and 2 days WFH. Lead and advise on APAC/ANZ financing activities, including the preparation, review and negotiation of relevant legal documentation, ensuring transactions are appropriately structured and managed from a legal and risk perspective. Manage corporate paperwork and documentation, including drafting, reviewing and negotiating agreements, board materials, resolutions and other corporate documents required to support the business. Advise on and manage intercompany arrangements across multiple jurisdictions, working with internal stakeholders and international teams to ensure agreements are commercially appropriate and legally compliant. Independently manage a diverse portfolio of legal matters at Special Counsel level, exercising sound judgement and taking ownership of matters from initial advice through to completion with minimal supervision. Provide legal and governance support across the global business, working with stakeholders across Australia, the US, Singapore and Europe and advising on matters including supply chain, commercialisation and new product initiatives. Requirements: Role Requirements Senior corporate lawyer at Special Counsel level with the ability to independently manage a broad range of legal matters with minimal supervision. Strong corporate and commercial experience, with exposure to APAC/ANZ financing, corporate documentation, intercompany arrangements and governance. Experience working within complex, multinational or listed-company environments, ideally with exposure to ASX and/or NASDAQ-listed organisations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide practical, commercially focused advice across a global business and work effectively with teams across Australia, the US, Singapore and Europe. beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:67.title: Project Manager, Revenue Operations
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:67.description: THE OPPORTUNITY We are looking for a delivery-focused Project Manager to run acquisition migrations end-to-end as Beacon standardizes each newly acquired company onto a common GTM stack. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who runs several projects at once against a hard deadline, keeps a lot of moving parts coordinated, and raises the bar on the quality of work around them. Beacon acquires roughly one software company per week which is then integrated into our standardized GTM stack. This role partners with newly acquired companies starting from the first discovery call, through CRM and Support Ticketing builds, until systems are fully rolled out. This role coordinates internal resources and ensures the portfolio company is trained on the tech stack while adhering to an SLA and making the process more repeatable with every acquisition. This role is responsible for running the project, meaning holding the timeline, managing the stakeholders, directing the build resources, and making sure what ships is right. This role will be partnered with a technical RevOps resource to help with deeper technical support, but this role will be responsible for speaking to the toolset at a high-level. WHAT YOU WOULD OWN - Migration delivery. Acquisition migrations against our SLA, owned end to end: scoping, project planning, sequencing the CRM and Support Ticketing builds, coordinating data migration, and making sure the team is trained and confident at go-live. You would lead discovery calls to assess their current stack and map it to Beacon's standards, hold the plan and the timeline across several concurrent migrations, manage dependencies and risks before they become slips, and own the status. - Contractor direction and quality. You would direct the work of pooled implementation contractors assigned to your migrations, pull in technical support when a problem genuinely needs it, make day-to-day scope and sequencing calls within the documented playbook, and escalate only genuine exceptions. - Delivery process. Improving the migration playbook as you run against it — tightening the plan, the checklists, and the handoffs so each acquisition goes faster and more predictably than the last. WHO YOU ARE - You have 3–5 years project or program management, running implementation, migration or change management projects — ideally in B2B SaaS, professional services, or consulting. You ideally have managed multiple projects concurrently against firm deadlines.. - You are literate in Go-To-Market systems. You understand how a CRM and a support platform are put together and can scope a build, and hold a credible conversation with a founder about their GTM tech stack. - You have directed the work of others — contractors, an agency pod, or junior admins — even without formal people management. - A confident stakeholder-facing communicator. You’re a people person who can understand hesitant stakeholders and help them feel excited during a period of a lot of change. - Strong judgment under ambiguity. You make defensible calls from a playbook instead of escalating everything, and you know which exceptions genuinely warrant escalation. - A quality bar you set rather than inherit. You care how the build looks six months after go-live, not just at handoff. - Strong written communication. Much of this job is a clear status update landing in the right inbox at the right time - A bias for action. You would rather move something forward than perfect the plan - The agility to adapt when a program changes shape mid-stream, and the confidence to get hands-on when it needs you NICE TO HAVE - Formal project management training or certification (PMP or similar). - Familiar with project management tools (Asana, JIRA, Monday.com http://Monday.com). - Hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, PipeDrive, Zoho, etc.) - Hands-on Support experience (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, etc.) - M&A exposure, particularly post-close systems consolidation. - Familiarit

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Co-Found with Founders Factory - Green Energy Studio (Thailand)
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London and operating globally, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of expert operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, FF has backed 450+ portfolio companies helping them to secure over 500 enterprise pilots with blue chip corporate partners such as Aviva, Northwestern Medicine, Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and HSBC. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high growth companies. We have created the fastest way to build a successful startup. We specialise in building founding teams, developing disruptive concepts, finding your first customer, and raising your first round. We know that starting and growing a business is hard so we’ve designed the people, processes, and platform to remove as much friction as possible. The Opportunity: Southeast Asia's energy transition is one of the largest economic shifts of the next decade, and Thailand sits at the centre of it. Energy demand keeps climbing, yet less than 1% of Thai households have solar, factories run on decades-old infrastructure, and businesses face rising pressure from carbon regulation at home and abroad. The systems that power homes, industry, and agriculture were not built for what comes next. The tools to change this now exist: cheap solar and storage, embedded finance, smart optimisation software, and new markets for carbon and clean energy proof. What's missing are the companies, built for Thailand's market realities, that put these pieces together at scale. Backed by one of Thailand's largest energy groups, these ventures launch with distribution, industrial customers, and balance sheet access most startups spend years earning. We are looking for exceptional entrepreneurs ready to build the future of clean energy in Thailand and beyond. Whether you're a founder post-exit hunting your next venture, an operator who has scaled a business from the inside and is ready to run your own, or a domain expert who knows this market cold, Founders Factory is the world's best cofounder. Our areas of focus: - Residential Solar Subscription - FinTech Marketplace for C&I Energy Upgrades - Energy Optimisation Platform to VPP - Agricultural Waste into Carbon-Negative Inputs (Industry, Products, Farming) - Payment-Linked Climate Rewards What’s in it for you? - Co-found a company with Founders Factory’s team of IPO-exited founders and experienced operators - A validated problem space and early venture thesis - Access to a team of senior operators across product, engineering, data and growth. - Support from a Venture Builder, someone who can help build and validate quickly - Unlock pre-seed investment of €275k spin out capital - Join our 6-month venture build and acceleration programme - Access to the Founders Factory ecosystem, network and investors - Collaborate with industry-leading corporates, including healthcare system partners

southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:5b99b663-4.description: ABOUT TOWN Town is AI that starts from who you are. We build a persistent model of your identity, your voice, your judgment, your relationships, and your priorities, and use it to do real work on your behalf across every tool where you operate: email, calendar, documents, Slack, and more. Town doesn't wait for you to prompt it. It observes, learns, and acts. The more you use it, the more it becomes an extension of you. Town was founded by Jean-Denis Greze (CEO), former CTO of Plaid, and Tony Vincent (CPO), former Director of Applied AI Product at Google. We're a small, talent-dense team backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, and Conviction, with more than $73M raised to date. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re growing our Product Support team here at Town. We’re looking for someone to own the experience users have when something about the product isn’t working for them - and to make sure that happens less and less over time. Town operates in the places people do their most important work, and supports users’ ways of working in highly varied and sophisticated ways. The support team at Town is AI-pilled, technical, and cares deeply about building trust and leading with kindness and empathy. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll take the cases that need more than a help article, own the quality of our support end to end, and turn what you learn from every ticket into docs, tooling, and product feedback that make the whole system sharper. The bar isn't clearing a queue, it's that a user walks away trusting Town more than they did before they ran into the problem they surfaced. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own inbound support end to end. You take pride in owning the queue, knowing that there’s a team of engineers and GTM folks who have your back and will help solve the problems getting surfaced. - Take the hard cases. Dig past surface level on issues and bugs, understand billing and commercial issues, read logs and traces, and get to the bottom of novel, ambiguous problems, partnering with & escalating to engineers when you need to. You’re comfortable directly engaging with customers on a live meeting or phone call if needed. - Make Town's own AI part of the support engine. Use Town to become a product expert. Leverage our internal tooling to investigate faster, and shape AI-assisted support flows so automated answers stay accurate, on-brand, and actually helpful. - Turn tickets into fixes for everyone. Spot patterns, surface them to product and engineering, and drive down contact rates so the same issue doesn't come back. - Build the support foundation. Write the docs, playbooks, and help content that let support scale past you — feel comfortable noticing and solving gaps and problems. - Be the voice of the user. Bring customer pain points and wins directly back into the product roadmap and customer messaging, so what we ship reflects what users actually feel. - Set the quality bar.
